title: Form validation
summary: Wraps a form and shows the browser's constraint validation well: messages in each field, a summary with links, focus on the first problem, and live re-checking.

props.name: validate
props.description: When to check: blur (after leaving a field, and on submit), input (while typing) or submit (only on submit). A field already showing an error re-checks as you type.

props.name: showValid
props.description: Also shows the valid state on fields that hold a value.

props.name: summary
props.description: Shows a summary of the problems with links to the fields.

events.name: pk-invalid
events.detail: { count: number, controls: Element[], messages: string[] }
events.description: A submit was stopped because these controls are invalid.

methods.name: validateAll()
methods.description: Checks every control now; returns true when all are valid.

a11y: Turns the native bubble off and puts each message in the field as a polite live region with aria-invalid on the control; the first invalid control takes focus on submit; the summary is role=alert and its links move focus. Custom text per constraint: data-msg-required, data-msg-type, data-msg-pattern, data-msg-min, data-msg-max on the control.

examples.title: Validated form with summary
examples.html:
<pk-form summary>
  <form>
    <pk-field label="Name" required><pk-input name="name" required data-msg-required="Enter a name."></pk-input></pk-field>
    <pk-field label="Email" required><pk-input name="email" type="email" required data-msg-type="Use the form name@example.com."></pk-input></pk-field>
    <pk-button type="submit">Save</pk-button>
  </form>
</pk-form>
